"It hasn't just assimilated our data," she breathes out, "it has integrated our *logic*. It knows how this station was designed to function, and it is rewriting the blueprint in real-time."

"The only remaining structural weakness," she says, her focus razor sharp despite the danger, "is that redundancy check in the navigation loop. It assumes linearity."
